6. **Confirmation Email**: A brief email from good@good.com to temp@temp.com with the body 'Thanks'.
7. **Marketing Campaign Brief**: Alex Johnson from Innovative Toys Inc. requests a marketing campaign proposal for the 'Space Explorer' toy line targeting children aged 6-12.
8. **Speaking Invitation**: Melissa Carter invites Casey to speak on a marketing panel at TechCon on May 15th.
